scope: Durable owner-level population and backfill of opaque notification group keys

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.derived_bound: at most 104 bytes under the existing 64-byte owner and UUID contracts
policy.group_semantics: all notification variants and target kinds for one source-owned target UUID share one group
policy.target_kind_boundary: target kind remains routing and authorization metadata and is intentionally excluded from grouping
policy.new_postgres_rows: BEFORE INSERT trigger fills only NULL group_key values
policy.new_sqlite_rows: AFTER INSERT trigger fills only NULL group_key values in the same transaction
policy.explicit_keys: preexisting or explicitly inserted non-NULL group keys are preserved
policy.candidate_compatibility: candidate finalization may continue to submit NULL and receives the durable derived value from persistence
policy.state_boundary: population changes no notification state or inbox timestamps
policy.delivery_boundary: population creates or mutates no delivery attempt
policy.api_boundary: no producer descriptor or shared notifications API change is introduced
policy.transport_boundary: no HTTP GraphQL native server function admin or storefront adapter is delivered

not_delivered: grouped aggregate summaries unread totals and latest-item projections
external inbox transport and UI adapters
tenant-wide scheduled reconciliation and payload redaction
search index SEO and deep-link migration
